content.context: Integrated 5 devl.dev toast variants, dual-month date range picker, homepage filter toolbar, live server logs cockpit, and reactive notification backend engine with undo store.
content.decision: Use Node.js global state for undo actions and in-memory notification queue, bridging real-time client toasts with Next.js App Router API endpoints.
content.rationale: Replaced raw clobbering shadcn installations with custom ported components adhering to semantic typography tokens and WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast. Provided robust in-memory undo buffer and localhost health telemetry.
